note: Themed baskets: equal-weight groups of stocks for ideas no single ETF captures. A watchlist, not recorded ideas. Members come from IBKR's theme data (search_investment_topics / get_theme_details) and the dossier; every member is checked with IBKR (search_contracts for a US listing, get_price_snapshot avg_90d_usd_volume of at least about $20M; names in the standard universe skip the volume check). The snapshot is IBKR's change from the prior close at the time shown, delayed about 15 minutes.

baskets.name: Texas power
baskets.story: Generators and utilities whose growth case leans on ERCOT data-center load. A Texas data-center moratorium, which the governor's race put on the table, hits them directly; regulated utilities elsewhere (XLU) far less.
baskets.watch: Texas count and any statement from the governor-elect or PUCT on large-load interconnection; ERCOT large-load queue updates.
baskets.source: IBKR theme Data Center Power; dossier 2026-11-03

members.why: Texas-based ERCOT generator; 1.2 GW Comanche Peak colocation deal with AWS and a stated 10-15 GW ERCOT data-center load target
Houston-based; the largest ERCOT retail supplier with Texas generation
Mostly PJM nuclear, but its Freestone Texas site hosts a CyrusOne data center under a recent PUCT approval: a partial Texas name
Houston electric utility whose load forecast leans on data-center interconnections

baskets.name: Texas AI hosts
baskets.story: Former bitcoin miners converting Texas sites into AI data centers. They carry the moratorium risk on new capacity; the chip makers in SMH sell to data centers everywhere.
baskets.watch: The same Texas policy headlines; bitcoin, which still drives part of their revenue; hyperscaler lease announcements.
baskets.source: IBKR themes Data Centers, Data Center Power; dossier 2026-11-03

baskets.name: Data-center power equipment
baskets.story: Suppliers of power, cooling and grid gear for AI data centers, national rather than Texas-specific. They fall when the market doubts the pace of the build-out, against industrials as a whole.
baskets.watch: Hyperscaler capex guidance (earnings), order and backlog updates, any federal or state limits on data-center grid hookups.

members.why: IBKR's top-ranked Data Center Power name: UPS, power distribution and cooling
Grid-to-chip power management; data-center orders up sharply
Gas turbines and grid equipment; $2.4B of data-center electrification orders in Q1
Fuel cells for on-site data-center power (Oracle's 2.45 GW deployment)
Power ICs for AI servers; about a third of revenue from AI and servers

baskets.name: Utility-scale solar
baskets.story: US utility-scale solar equipment makers, which gain if a Democratic Congress protects or extends clean-energy credits. Against XLU, the bet is on the policy, not on power demand.
baskets.watch: Senate control calls; statements on the clean-energy tax credits; tariff news on imported modules.

members.why: Largest US module maker; pure play on US utility-scale demand
Nextpower: solar trackers and balance-of-system for utility-scale plants
Electrical balance-of-system for utility-scale solar and storage

baskets.name: Managed care
baskets.story: Health insurers, whose margins hang on Medicare Advantage rates and ACA and Medicaid funding, all set in Washington. A Democratic sweep changes those odds; the names split between Medicare Advantage-heavy (HUM, UNH) and ACA/Medicaid-heavy (CNC, ELV), so the basket is a test of the policy read, not a one-way bet.
baskets.watch: Medicare Advantage rate notices, ACA subsidy extension talk, company earnings (several report in early November).
